answers.explanation: A byte is 8 bits, the smallest chunk most computers can move in one instruction.
A word is one or more bytes. Its size depends on the architecture.
The word matches the registers: 64 bits is 8 bytes.
10¹² ÷ 1,073,741,824 ≈ 931. Nothing is missing; the units differ.
Networks are measured in bits per second, because they move data one bit at a time.
PB is 1,024 TB, which is 1,024 × 1,024 GB.
